caption:
OpenAI's cheapest paid tier, ChatGPT Go, is $8 a month. Before you downgrade to save $12, know what you're giving up.

Go doesn't include Agent mode, Deep Research, ChatGPT Sites, or ChatGPT Work — the features most useful for actual client work: research, drafting sites, and delegating multi-step tasks. It also shows ads. Plus, at $20, is the first tier that unlocks all of that.

If you're deciding between the two, ask yourself this before you pick a plan:

"List every task I use ChatGPT for in a normal week. For each one, tell me whether ChatGPT Go or ChatGPT Plus supports it, based on: Agent mode, Deep Research, Sites, Work, and ad-free use."

Paste your own task list into that prompt and you'll get a clearer answer than any pricing page.

Save this before your next renewal.
